account: Morphing I led a government-funded data project on AI Hub, run by the National Information Society Agency. The dataset, opened on 28 June 2024, shows that the robot gathered 109,350 labeled records from water mains in Jeju, Siheung, Jeonju and Jindo in 2023. A project partner handled inspection and the response to the quality check by the Telecommunications Technology Association. The dataset notes that external sound recordings did not differ much between types of anomaly. In its account for the International Telecommunication Union, current as of June 2025, Morphing I reports that municipal pilots inspected more than 30 km of pipelines and produced validated inspection data. The developer states that the system is in early commercialization. The account provides no independent verification of the reported gains. Avoided leaks and failures remain unmeasured.
